[A822] REVIEW READY
Commit: 9a71daa9aa2379e2a57eb93ccafe83101bcb37f7 (branch `pf-973-1` on `dd163e41`, PR base `dev-soft-core`)

Changed:
- `sw/firmware/ctrl/srp/srp_mbx.c` and `srp_mbx.h`: each interface carries `link_carried`, the level of the last
  LINK the loop dispatched; attach gives it the register's level.
- SRP's poll now reads `links[n] = mbx_link_up(n) && m->ifs[n].link_carried`.
  - A DOWN is still taken from the LINK register, so a link lost while a full ring holds its record fails closed.
  - An UP is taken only while the last LINK carried one. A link that comes up after a pass's events is therefore
    still SRP's first UP: it resets nothing and keeps the clean startup participants. A later UP resets once.
- `sw/firmware/ctrl/test/srp_link_pass.cpp` (new): the host test. The link moves at four phases of a pass; the test
  runs in a process of its own at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if (`srp_arms.link_pass_arms`).
- `srp_fixture.hpp`: `boot(link_up, ahead)`.
- `srp_link_mutants.py` (new): seven plants. The existing `srp-poll-extra-read` follows its moved site.
- The SRP README and the changelog.
- No RTL, mailbox contract, loop, CPU budget bound or harness file changed.
- A first version recorded the level in the loop (`ctrl_loop_link_up`). It put the 8x8/1if platform image at 58.5
  RAMB36, past its ledgered 58, so the level moved into SRP's interface. Those commits stay in the history.

Validation (at `862fd41c`; `9a71daa9` only rewraps a test module's docstring; the docs steps ran at `9a71daa9`):
- the test at its own commit `406c4a89`, on the base firmware: `SrpLinkPass.AfterTheEventsBeforeSrpsPoll` FAILS at
  both shapes. The first UP resets twice and loses the startup participants; a later UP resets twice. The other
  three phases pass. At the head all four pass at 1x1/1if, 8x8/1if and 8x8/2if;
- `test_ctrl_firmware.py --require-rv32 --self-test`, 4 shards: PASS. Suites 77 of 77; control 826 of 826; AECP 385
  `[ok]`; SRP 564 `[ok]`; 0 escaped;
- the seven plants are caught in the 1x1/1if, 8x8/1if and 1x1/2if campaigns, each by its named test's own words;
- `fw_coverage.py --selftest` and `--check`: PASS;
- twin, twin-plants, twin-maps, twin-maps-plants: PASS, 0 findings, every plant refused;
- `plat_ledger.py` at every point: PASS at base and head. RAMB36 45 / 46 / 58 / 63 unchanged; ROM +16 / +24 / +8 /
  +16 B; SRAM unchanged. The image diff is `srp_mbx.o`'s code, plus offset-only changes at 8x8;
- CPU budget harness, 10 groups at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if, base against head: 0 refusals and 0 budget misses each
  side; 88 and 86 probes paired; 0 verdicts changed; largest difference 0.438 ms against 20 ms;
- `flip_grade --check --point 1x1/1if` and `--point 8x8/1if`, `load_grade --check`, `shape_costs --check`: PASS,
  byte-identical to the base. 1x1/1if: load 0.511, last queued notice 127.31 ms, ACMP 29.06 ms, txL 47.88 ms.
  8x8/1if: load 0.744;
- split boot simulation: 1x1 and 8x8 PASS; self-test 6 of 6 native controls and 6 of 6 plants;
- docs workflow steps: 104 of 104; builder legs 0 and 1: PASS, each with its declared NOT RUN arm.

Acceptance criteria:
- A link-up at any phase of a pass resets SRP's interface once, keeping the startup participants: met. A first UP
  resets nothing and keeps them; a later UP resets once; at each of the four phases, both shapes.
- The host test of that ordering fails before the fix and passes after, at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if, with a planted
  defect: met (seven plants).
- The CPU budget rows unchanged within their bounds: met. The graders are byte-identical, and the measured legs
  change no verdict.
- The images within their ledgers: met at every point.

Open risks/questions:
- A DOWN inside a pass still resets twice (register, then its record), before any rebuild; out of #973's scope.
- A LINK that SRP's sink drops on a re-entry (counted, asserted in debug builds) is not carried; a dropped UP waits
  for the next LINK.
- The 8x8/1if platform image is 48 B of ROM below its next half-tile.
- The second-hart lane (#872) changes the same poll line on two harts; that lane owns the merge of the two.

[A822] REVIEW READY
Commit: 5759780f2251ef25221c6a395250312dce656ca4
Round 2, PR #978; local branch `pf-973-1`, PR base `dev-soft-core`. Four local commits after `9a71daa9`.

F1: `srp_link_mutants.py` is classified in `ctrl_configs.py`'s `OUTSIDE` list with its non-compiling role stated.
`ctrl_boundary.py --require-rv32 --selftest` now passes locally: 4,455 compiled sources, zero findings,
117 boundary + 185 pin + 4 figure controls, zero misbehaved controls.

F2: SRP recovers after a re-attach that reads DOWN when its record is elided. A poll marks an uncarried register UP;
a later poll takes it only after a pass whose event take emptied the ring. Pending LINK events still arrive before
that fallback, preserving #973's first-UP behavior. The committed re-attach probe fails on `9a71daa9`'s firmware
at both shipping shapes and passes with the fix. Its ordinary later-UP control passes on both. A full-ring ordering
test and four more planted defects cover the fallback.

F3: retained and documented. Skipping the second DOWN reset adds 16 B to the current 8x8/1if image; that prototype
is refused at 58.5 RAMB36 against the unchanged 58-tile ledger. F4: the README states that marked recovery also
recovers an UP dropped by the re-entry guard. F5: the prepared PR body relates to #665, #970, #972, and #872.

Validation at this exact head:
- `test_ctrl_firmware.py --require-rv32 --self-test --shard K/4 --jobs 8`, K=0..3: PASS. 77 suite verdicts;
  control 826/826 caught; AECP 385 `[ok]`; SRP 576 `[ok]`; no escaped plants in the final gate.
- Eleven link plants killed at 1x1/1if, 8x8/1if, and 1x1/2if. The reviewer register-UP and sink-double-reset plants
  also remain killed. The old OR planting site is replaced by the committed OR plant at the new line.
- The reviewer's clear-carried-on-DOWN control escapes: the new fallback restores the same state and single reset,
  potentially one poll later. The escaped result is retained; that development campaign is not claimed all green.
- `fw_coverage.py --selftest` and `--check`: PASS, 40 files.
- `make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp twin twin-plants twin-maps twin-maps-plants`: PASS, zero findings, plants caught.
- CPU `run.py` at `1x1` and `8x8-1if`, all ten groups: PASS. 88/86 paired probes; zero refusals, budget misses,
  per-pass-share misses, or changed verdicts. Largest absolute base/head difference 0.217 ms against a 20 ms bound.
- `flip_grade.py --check` at both shipping points, `load_grade.py --check`, and `shape_costs.py --check`: PASS,
  byte-identical to base. Loads 0.511/0.744 against 0.70/0.75; 1x1 last notice 127.31 ms, ACMP 29.06 ms,
  txL 47.88 ms. The stored last-notice gate remains 130 ms, tighter than the owner's 140 ms ceiling.
- `plat_ledger.py`: PASS at all four points. ROM 126488/128104/139256/140856 B; SRAM unchanged;
  45/46/58/63 RAMB36 unchanged. The 8x8/1if ROM has 8 B before its next allocation.
- Documentation workflow gate steps: 104/104 PASS. Builder legs 0/1 pass with one declared NOT RUN arm each
  (an ineffective environment-option plant and a missing physical calibration report, respectively).
- Split boot: 1x1 and 8x8 PASS; self-test 6/6 native controls and 6/6 planted defects.

No RTL, mailbox contract, loop, budget bound, or budget harness change. The working tree is clean; no push or PR
edit was performed. Receipts, exact commands, and the indexed mutation logs accompany the Round 2 packet.

Independent re-review, the manager's push and hosted/local workflow reruns, merge-candidate validation,
existing fit/timing obligations, and post-merge bench scenarios remain required. This is author evidence,
not review approval or LAB qualification.

[A822] REVIEW READY
Commit: 87b2fc0f2867ef132b9388e22ec262fc626cbb57
Round 3, PR #978; local branch `pf-973-1`, PR base `dev-soft-core`. Four local commits after `5759780f`.

R896-2-F1 (stale uncarried-UP mark): fixed. When the register read DOWN, the poll skipped the mark update, so the
mark of an UP that was later elided survived the DOWN. A fresh UP after a later pass's take could then be taken on
the old mark, and its own LINK reset the interface a second time. `carried_up` now runs on every poll with the
level the register read. While no LINK has carried an UP, a DOWN read writes 0 and clears the mark
(`srp_mbx.c:1286-1294`, the poll at `:1309`). So the mark holds only while every poll reads the link up, and an UP
after a DOWN is taken from its own LINK: the first keeps the startup participants, and a later one resets once.
- Unchanged: re-attach / elided-DOWN recovery, the immediate fail-closed DOWN, carried-UP handling, and the
  first-UP and later-UP reset rules.
- Size: `.text` is byte-identical at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if, and +4 B at 2if.
- Stated assumption: a DOWN that no poll reads lasts less than the gap between two polls. A dropped autonegotiated
  link waits at least `break_link_timer`, 1,200 ms (IEEE 802.3-2022 28.3.2), before it renegotiates. The code
  comment, the SRP README and the PR state this.

Tests first (`d9f8929d`): `SrpLinkPassElided.AnElidedUpAuthorizesNoFreshFirstUp` and `...FreshLaterUp`, in the link
suite's own process at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if.
- Both FAIL at `5759780f` at both shapes, PASS with `9a71daa9`'s SRP sources, and PASS at this head.
- The reviewer's unmodified `probe_stale_mark.cpp` and `run_focused.py` pass at both shapes (10/10).
- Their `run_controls.py` passes 4/4: the prior-production control and the re-attach probe.
- Plants: `link-pass-mark-survives-a-down`, `-later` and `link-pass-mark-masked-before-the-shift` are new; the
  changed lines' plants are replanted.
- `rv-poll-resets-on-register-up`, `rv-sink-double-reset` and `link-pass-attach-carries-an-up` stay killed.
- My first form of the `mark-survives` plants did not compile. Its raw ESCAPED result is kept and not counted;
  `9509dbd3` corrects it.
- README lines 120-123 and the code comment now state when the mark's observation is valid.

R895-1-F1 (retained): the source fix is unchanged. The local boundary gate passes at this head. The hosted
`firmware-boundary` job at the pushed head is still needed, and the PR body says so.

Validation at this exact head:
- `test_ctrl_firmware.py --require-rv32 --self-test --shard K/4 --jobs 8`, K=0..3: PASS.
  - 77 suite verdicts; control 826 caught; AECP 385 `[ok]`; SRP 585 `[ok]`; 0 escaped.
  - All 14 link plants are killed at 1x1/1if, 8x8/1if and 1x1/2if.
- `ctrl_boundary.py --require-rv32 --selftest`: PASS. 4,455 compiled sources, 0 findings; 117 boundary, 185 pin and
  4 figure controls; 0 misbehaved.
- `fw_coverage.py --selftest` and `--check`: PASS, 40 files.
- `make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp twin twin-plants twin-maps twin-maps-plants`: PASS.
- CPU `run.py` at `1x1` and `8x8-1if`, all ten groups: PASS.
  - 88 / 86 probes; 0 refusals, budget misses or share misses; no verdict changed against base or round 2.
  - Largest base/head difference 0.204 ms against 20 ms.
- `flip_grade.py --check` at both shipping points, `load_grade.py --check` and `shape_costs.py --check`: PASS,
  byte-identical to base.
  - Loads 0.511 / 0.744 against 0.70 / 0.75.
  - 1x1: last notice 127.31 ms, ACMP 29.06 ms, txL 47.88 ms. The stored last-notice gate stays 130 ms.
- `plat_ledger.py`: PASS at all four points, 0 findings.
  - ROM 126,488 / 128,112 / 139,256 / 140,856 B; 45 / 46 / 58 / 63 RAMB36 unchanged.
  - 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if are identical to the previous head in every size field.
- Docs workflow steps: 104/104 PASS. Builder legs 0 / 1: PASS, with the same declared NOT RUN arm each as before.
- Split boot: 1x1 and 8x8 PASS; self-test native controls and planted defects caught.

No RTL, mailbox contract, loop, budget bound or budget harness change. The working tree is clean; no push or PR
edit was made.

Still required: the manager's push, the hosted and local workflow reruns, independent re-review, merge-candidate
validation, the existing fit/timing obligations and the post-merge bench scenarios. This is author evidence, not
review approval or LAB qualification.
